xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2866 - release prefer coverage-debt hatch when no open debt issue

plan.title: release: prefer --allow-coverage-debt=#N when no open coverage-debt issue (don't interrupt cut for hairlines)

narratives.Description: During release Step 5, hairline branch-coverage misses should file a debt issue and use --allow-coverage-debt=#N when no open coverage-debt issue exists. Soft-pass while a prior hatch debt issue is still open remains forbidden. Non-coverage check failures stay under #2859 file-and-merge.
narratives.Overview: Release-skill default: hatch coverage hairlines when no open debt issue; fix when debt is unpaid.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting a release, I want Step 5 coverage hairlines to use the debt hatch when the ledger is empty, so that the cut is not interrupted for a 0.01pp restore mid-release.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json, update the deft-directive-release skill body: (1) Phase 1 / Step 5 recovery — on branch-coverage threshold failure only, if no open coverage-debt GitHub issue exists, file #N and continue with --allow-coverage-debt=#N (PowerShell-safe form); if an open debt issue from a prior hatch exists, forbid another soft-pass and require restore >=85%. (2) Replace the Anti-Patterns bullet that bans consecutive soft-pass via prior-CHANGELOG citation (#2618/#2573) with the open-issue ledger rule. (3) Cross-link #2859 so non-coverage failures stay file-and-merge. Then run task packs:render so content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md updates. Mirror a short operator note in docs/RELEASING.md. Optionally add content/packs/lessons/lessons-pack-0.1.json entry. Verify with rg for allow-coverage-debt / open coverage-debt / #2866 in the rendered skill and RELEASING.md. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] cites #2866. Do not edit AGENTS.md or content/templates/agents-entry.md. Do not cancel #2865.

items.title: Given Step 5 fails only on branch coverage below 85% and no open coverage-debt issue exists, when the release skill is followed, then the agent files #N and continues with --allow-coverage-debt=#N.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a hairline coverage miss and no open debt issue, when Phase 1/Step 5 recovery runs, then the skill requires file-#N-then-hatch and does not require mid-cut coverage restore.

items.title: Given an open coverage-debt issue from a prior hatch still exists, when Step 5 fails on coverage, then soft-pass is forbidden until coverage is restored or the issue is closed after restore.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an open debt issue, when the skill Anti-Patterns are read, then reusing --allow-coverage-debt is marked forbidden.

items.title: Given non-coverage Step 5 failures, when the skill is followed, then #2859 file-and-merge still applies.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a hang or failing test at Step 5, when the skill is read, then the coverage-hatch carve-out does not apply.

items.title: Given the change lands, when AGENTS.md is inspected, then it was not bulks for this rule.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the PR diff, when AGENTS.md and agents-entry are checked, then no new always-pin for this reminder was added.

references.title: Issue #2866: release: prefer --allow-coverage-debt=#N when no open coverage-debt issue (don't interrupt cut for hairlines)

expected_outputs: release skill open-issue ledger hatch rule
